question.text: Ethical selling of Cat III AIFs to an unsuitable client is:

answer.text: Prohibited — product must be suitable before any recommendation

explanation.text: The Logic: Prohibited. Suitability is a non-negotiable prerequisite; disclosure alone doesn't justify unsuitable sales. The Trap: Other options rationalise mis-selling. Cross-Exam Context: Fundamental ethical rule. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Document reasons for NOT recommending to ineligible clients — shows discipline.
